newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Hainan Airlines to issue B shares.
newsitem.headline: China's Hainan Airlines to issue B shares.

text.p: China's Hainan Airlines has received approval to issue 71 million yuan worth of B shares in the near future, the China Securities newspaper said on Friday.
After issuing B shares, the airline plans to issue A shares, the newspaper said but gave no more details.
The company is based on the southern island of Hainan.
A company spokeswoman said in August that it intended to list 75 million B shares on the Shanghai market.
The company is 25 percent owned by American Aviation Investment, a fund partially controlled by U.S. financier George Soros, making it the first Chinese airline to become a joint venture company.
